_comment: Castalia-Penta (CPR3): the Castalia defaults plus a FIFTH hart, and the RENUMBER -- HART 0 is the always-on soft ORCHESTRATOR in the centre band and harts 1-4 are the hardened corner channel tiles. numHarts=5 grows the fabric through the existing single sources (arbiter/resv N=5+, MW 2->3, CLINT/irq_router/debug NHARTS=5, and the CLINT layout SHIFTS: mtime 0x5020, mtimecmp[0] 0x5030 -- derive CLINT addresses from NHARTS, never hardcode); orchestrator=true makes hart 0 an `orch_tile` that keeps every hart-0 wiring special it already had (SPI0 flash/XIP quartet, sleep_cpu, trap pin, the a0 pass/fail gate, tcm_pgen pgen_mem(1), arbiter slice 0, no pwr_ctrl row, no iso clamps) while harts 1-4 become FULLY UNIFORM tiles -- pwr_ctrl NHARTS=5, so PWRCR gains bit 4 and every tile 1-4 is gateable. It also selects MEMORY MAP v2: SH_AW 15->16, five read-only TCM apertures at 0x20000 + 0x4000*h (management-hart-only; a gated tile's window completes with zeros), pages 0x34000-0x3FFFF the unmapped gap, and extended flash at 0x40000. The AFE bank follows the tiles (AFE0-3 OWNER_HART 1-4); the EIS engine and the afe_stub management privilege stay on hart 0, which is why MGMT_HART is never overridden any more. Build with: make chip CONFIG=config/penta.json ; prove with: make verify CONFIG=config/penta.json
